function.name: run_sql
function.arguments:
{"sql":"SELECT sku, period,
       SUM(qty) AS total_qty,
       SUM(amount_cad) AS total_amount_cad,
       SUM(amount_cad)/SUM(qty) AS avg_unit_cost_cad,
       AVG(contract_unit_price) AS avg_contract_price_cad,
       SUM(amount_cad) - SUM(qty * contract_unit_price) AS excess_cost_cad
FROM lightning.metastore.finmozg.finance_usl.purchase_line
WHERE sku IN ('NUT-ALM','NUT-CAS','NUT-PEC')
  AND period IN ('2026-08','2026-09')
GROUP BY sku, period
ORDER BY sku, period","purpose":"Compute quantities, costs, average unit cost, contract price, excess cost for the three SKUs per period"}
